MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What should you say when giving feedback on someone's reading? (1 mark)
   A. Something unkind
   B. Nothing
   C. One good thing and one thing to improve
   D. Only what was bad

2. Which sentence means "This is my older sister"? (1 mark)
   A. 那是我弟弟。
   B. 这是我爸爸。
   C. 这是我姐姐。
   D. 这是我妹妹。

3. Which sentence means "There is a television in the living room."? (1 mark)
   A. 客厅里有电视。
   B. 卧室里有床。
   C. 电视在客厅。
   D. 浴室在花园旁边。

4. What does 房间 (fángjiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Left side
   B. Beside
   C. Where
   D. Room

5. What does 学校 (xuéxiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. Tomorrow
   C. To go
   D. School

6. What does 十 (shí) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Three
   C. Nine
   D. Ten

7. What does 送 (sòng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Which number, how many
   B. To give (a gift)
   C. Candle
   D. Happy

8. Which word is pronounced chànggē? (1 mark)
   A. 号
   B. 唱歌
   C. 祝
   D. 快乐

9. Which word comes first in pinyin alphabetical order? (1 mark)
   A. xiāngjiāo
   B. bǐng
   C. chá
   D. mángguǒ

10. What does 蔬菜 (shūcài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Chicken (meat)
   C. Lunch
   D. Mango

11. What does 笑 (xiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Nose
   B. To look, to see
   C. To laugh, to smile
   D. To brush teeth

12. What is scanning? (1 mark)
   A. Looking for one particular word or fact
   B. Reading slowly word by word
   C. Drawing a picture
   D. Singing a song

13. What does 小 (xiǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Not
   B. Sun
   C. It rains
   D. Small

14. What does 雨 (yǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rain
   B. Snow
   C. Very
   D. Small

15. What does decoding a word mean? (1 mark)
   A. Using letters and sounds to work out how to say it
   B. Copying it
   C. Drawing it
   D. Hiding it

16. What does 窗户 (chuānghu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Window
   B. Is at, is in
   C. Fridge
   D. Toilet

17. In 十, which stroke is written first? (1 mark)
   A. Both together
   B. The vertical 竖
   C. The horizontal 横
   D. Neither

18. How many strokes does the character 大 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 3
   C. 2
   D. 5

19. What does 我家有五口人 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have five brothers
   B. My house has five rooms
   C. There are five people in my family
   D. I am five years old

20. Which sentence means "That is my younger brother."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我爸爸。
   B. 我家有五口人。
   C. 这是我妈妈。
   D. 那是我弟弟。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the eight basic strokes' names in Chinese with pinyin. Any six earn full marks. (3 marks)

22. Explain what the part 女 tells us in 妈, 姐 and 妹. (3 marks)

23. Explain the job of the apostrophe in the word nǚ'ér. (2 marks)

24. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the television?" (2 marks)

25. Write the pinyin for 爸爸, 妈妈 and 姐姐. (3 marks)

26. Explain how to pause when reading: what does a comma mean and what does a full stop mean? (3 marks)

27. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng. (2 marks)

28. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 妹妹 and 米饭. (2 marks)

29. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my father." (2 marks)

30. State three rules of stroke order and give an example of each. (3 marks)

31. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 学校 and 看. (2 marks)

32. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to eat bananas." (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — One good thing and one thing to improve
   Kind feedback names a strength and one suggestion.

2. C — 这是我姐姐。
   姐姐 is older sister.

3. A — 客厅里有电视。
   客厅里有电视。 (kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì.) means "There is a television in the living room.".

4. D — Room
   房间 (fángjiān) means room.

5. D — School
   学校 (xuéxiào) means school.

6. D — Ten
   十 (shí) means ten.

7. B — To give (a gift)
   送 (sòng) means to give (a gift).

8. B — 唱歌
   唱歌 is pronounced chànggē and means to sing.

9. B — bǐng
   b comes before c, m and x.

10. A — Vegetables
   蔬菜 (shūcài) means vegetables.

11. C — To laugh, to smile
   笑 (xiào) means to laugh, to smile.

12. A — Looking for one particular word or fact
   Scanning finds a specific detail.

13. D — Small
   小 (xiǎo) means small.

14. A — Rain
   雨 (yǔ) means rain.

15. A — Using letters and sounds to work out how to say it
   Decoding uses letter-sound knowledge.

16. A — Window
   窗户 (chuānghu) means window.

17. C — The horizontal 横
   Horizontal comes before vertical when they cross.

18. B — 3
   大 has 横, 撇 and 捺.

19. C — There are five people in my family
   五口人 is five people.

20. D — 那是我弟弟。
   那是我弟弟。 (nà shì wǒ dìdi.) means "That is my younger brother.".

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: 横 héng, 竖 shù, 撇 piě, 捺 nà, 点 diǎn, 提 tí, 横折 héngzhé, 竖钩 shùgōu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for six or more.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: 女 means woman or female, so the characters are for female family members.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the link to family, 1 mark for naming the three characters.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: It shows where one syllable ends and the next begins, nǚ + ér.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part of the explanation.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在哪儿? diànshì zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: bàba, māma, jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each with the correct tone marks.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: A comma is a short pause and a full stop is a longer pause, so you can breathe and the listener can follow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for comma, 1 mark for full stop, 1 mark for the reason.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: There is a bed in the bedroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: 妹妹: mèimei, younger sister. 米饭: mǐfàn, cooked rice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Top to bottom (三), left to right (好: 女 then 子), horizontal before vertical (十), 撇 before 捺 (人).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with an example.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 学校: xuéxiào, school. 看: kàn, to look, to see.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢吃香蕉。 wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
